Messages.Author: Akantes
Messages.Body:
Ok, I tried looking through search, but I'm really bad at those
things, and I didn't find my answer.

Eternal Mask:

Put this card on this vampire and move a unique vampire from any ash
heap to your ready region with any amount of blood from this acting
vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block, play
reaction cards or vote. You may burn this card and the chosen vampire
during any untap phase.

Am I correct on this:

Vampire A plays Eternal Mask, and targets Vampire B. On my next turn,
I feed Vampire A to Khobar Towers, Vampire B still stays in play
right?
